acceptance: Server keyword search request payloads support retained keyword, file type, size, source count, complete source count, and extension filters.
evidence: Added raria-ed2k server search request codec for retained keyword, type, extension, size, source count, and complete-source filters.

acceptance: Server TCP and UDP search results parse file hash, name, size, source counts, complete counts, type, extension, and source network metadata.
evidence: Added parser for server result payloads including hash, direct source endpoint, name, low/high size tags, source counts, type, extension, source network, and more-results marker.

acceptance: Parsed server search results produce startable ed2kUri values with safe names and truthful size/hash fields.
evidence: Parsed results now produce startable native ED2K file URIs with percent-encoded names, truthful size/hash fields, and inline source endpoints when present.
notes: Do not add aria2 RPC field names.

acceptance: Malformed or unrelated search payloads fail safely without partial native result state.
evidence: Malformed queries, empty payloads, truncated result rows, excessive result counts, invalid tags, and invalid direct source hosts are rejected through typed errors.
